name: genpark-distributed-agent-heartbeat-liveness-watchdog-skill
description: Distributed Agent Fleet Heartbeat & Liveness Watchdog. Monitors heartbeat signals across distributed autonomous agent nodes, dynamically computes jitter-aware failover deadlines ($T_{\text{timeout}} = \mu + 3\sigma$), isolates zombie/stalled workers, and coordinates state checkpoint hydration and failover rerouting.

tools.name: monitor_agent_fleet_liveness
tools.description: Record agent heartbeats, calculate dynamic jitter-aware timeout thresholds, detect dead or hung worker nodes, and trigger failover reassignments.
